title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and stabilizes in a population under social influence, policy mandates, information campaigns, and supply/cost constraints.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: Individuals observe mask usage among social neighbors and update their adoption probability accordingly.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Mandates and enforcement at locations affect individuals’ compliance and adoption decisions.

interactions.name: information_campaign
interactions.description: Broadcast messages increase awareness, perceived benefits, or trust, shifting adoption probabilities.

interactions.name: market_transaction
interactions.description: People purchase masks subject to price, inventory, budget, and perceived need.

interactions.name: mobility_and_presence
interactions.description: People visit locations per daily schedules, creating opportunities for enforcement and social observation.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of the population wearing masks at each timestep.

metrics.name: final_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Adoption rate at the end of the simulation period.

metrics.name: time_to_threshold
metrics.description: Days elapsed until a specified adoption threshold (e.g., 50% or 80%) is reached.

metrics.name: mandate_effect_size
metrics.description: Difference in adoption rate attributable to policy (e.g., with vs. without mandate scenario).

metrics.name: compliance_by_location_type
metrics.description: Average mask usage within each location type (household, workplace, public).

metrics.name: inequality_of_adoption
metrics.description: Dispersion of adoption across subgroups or regions (e.g., Gini or coefficient of variation).

metrics.name: violation_rate
metrics.description: Share of individuals entering mandate-required locations without masks.

metrics.name: average_mask_quality
metrics.description: Mean quality level among worn masks, weighted by usage.
